## OTITIS MEDIA
Streptococcus pneumoniae, Haemophilus influenza, and Moraxella catarrhalis are
the most common bacteria to cause otitis media.
## Preferred treatment
Patient has NOT received antibiotics in the prior month
Amoxicillin 1000 mg PO q8h for 10 days ($) [R]
Patient has received antibiotics in the prior month
Amoxicillin/clavulanate 875-125 mg PO q12h for 10 days ($) [R]
## Alternatives
[Assessment of Beta-lactam Reaction](orzid2-gmenu-abx-beta-lactam-allergy-assesment)
Cefdinir 300 mg PO q12h for 10 days ($) [R]
< OR >
Cefpodoxime 200 mg PO BID for 10 days ($$) [R]
